prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 医院门诊医生排班表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "心血管内科" spans 1 col × 3 row; "内分泌科" spans 1 col × 2 row; "骨科" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "科室" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "医生" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "职称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "出诊时间" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 138px
  col 5: header "擅长领域" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1042px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助患者按科室查找医生，了解其职称、出诊时间和擅长领域。","reading":"读者通常先定位科室，再逐行比较医生、出诊时间与专长；合并的科室单元格将同科医生组织成组，每位医生的一行应保持清晰可辨。","groups":["科室、医生和职称共同标识医生及其专业资历。","出诊时间和擅长领域共同帮助患者判断何时就诊以及医生是否适合自己的病情。"],"keep_intact":["医生姓名和职称应尽量保持在一行。","出诊时间中的单个星期与时段组合应保持完整，便于准确识别。","科室名称应尽量保持完整，尤其是合并单元格中的科室名称。"],"may_wrap":["擅长领域是较长的连续描述，可在自然语义位置换行，并利用每位医生行内增加的高度。","出诊时间可在不同出诊时段之间换行；专长描述造成的行高通常可以容纳这些换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [98, 67, 98, 159, 297] · table 720×779px · row heights [36, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [98, 67, 98, 115, 341] · table 720×663px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [78, 67, 82, 135, 357] · table 720×640px · row heights [36, 106, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"科室、姓名、职称和出诊时间均保持完整，合并科室清楚地组织了医生组，逐行核对很方便。","problems":"擅长领域普遍占四行，七位医生的行高都达到106px；相比之下，时间列保持单行所省出的行高没有实际发挥作用。","cause":"出诊时间列宽159px足以容纳完整时间，但将擅长领域压到297px，使描述频繁换行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"科室、姓名和职称保持单行；擅长领域加宽后，多数医生行降至三行，整体更紧凑。","problems":"出诊时间经常把第二个星期与时段拆开，如“周”与“四下午”分到两行，影响患者识别；首末医生的描述仍占四行。","cause":"时间列115px的内容宽度仅94px，行末可容下第二个“周”，却容不下完整的星期和时段；擅长领域列341px仍不足以让所有描述降至三行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"擅长领域获得357px，多数描述为三行，整体高度最低；姓名和表头仍保持单行。","problems":"科室名称和职称被拆成多行，削弱科室分组和医生资历的辨识；出诊时间也将星期与时段拆开。较短的表格以关键标识的完整性为代价。","cause":"科室列78px和职称列82px分别低于其单行所需的98px；时间列135px使部分第二时段在星期或时段中间断开。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"平衡完整性","widths":[98,67,98,105,351],"change":"恢复科室和职称的单行宽度，将时间列收至105px，让两个时段更可能在分隔处换行，并把余量给擅长领域。"},{"name":"完整时间","widths":[98,67,98,159,297],"change":"保留r0A作为时间信息完全单行的参照；若时间列在分隔处换行仍不理想，可优先选择此方案。"},{"name":"极窄时间","widths":[98,67,98,98,358],"change":"将时间列设为98px，尝试每行容纳一个完整时段，同时为擅长领域争取更多宽度；需检查标点和各时段的实际换行位置。"}]}
